title: Playing a Biloxi pier pavilion
summary: Discussion of the Biloxi hotel and dance pavilion on a pier where New Orleans musicians visited on Sundays.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Well, the only one that I remember now is Al Jordi, saxophonist, clarinet. That's the only one I remember. Uh, Steve Loicanna, I think, was playing bass. I'm sure that, uh, that's about the ones I remember now.
Oh, yeah. That was the Isle of, wait a minute, in Biloxi, the Isle of, uh, Capri was over there.
Well, I think it was the Bonifesto Hotel.
Yeah, we worked out on a pier, on a dance, dance pavilion. Mm-hmm. On the pier. It isn't there anymore.
Did you use Biloxi Boys over there?
